label: ANALYST PARAMETERS [PARAM]. Chosen by judgment; change them here and rebuild.
unit_cap_basis: Test-stage ceilings. SEARCH is limited by the volume of tightly relevant searches, unknown until a Keyword Planner forecast (X01). PARTNERS = at most two creator deals per month. Others: spend above this before a positive read is not a test.

platform_min_basis.TIKTOK: $20/day ad-group minimum [CE029] x 30.4 days (a campaign-level budget would need more than $50/day [CE028])

scale_rule: Inherited from docs/growth/ADS.md: more budget only after 3 paying customers from a creative with gross-profit CAC payback under 10 months and at least one renewal. Views, CTR or signups alone never earn budget.
cac_score_basis: LTV/CAC on capped base LTV. 1.0 = break-even. Lower bands are kept to rank channels that are all below break-even before any data exists.
reserve_basis: Below $1,000 a single channel is tested and a reserve would push it under its minimum viable test; unspent budget is simply not spent.
